Others information:
New customers having DOB/Birth between 1997 to 2012 and having NID can avail this SIM only.
Gen-Z new customer can enjoy the mentioned offers applicable for this package only by purchasing SIM from Teletalk Customer Care and downloading My Teletalk app/dial *111# & registering.
Existing customers who were born between 1997 and 2012 can dial *111# or click on My Teletalk app banner to receive only promotional offers such as special data offers; bundle offers and unlimited data offers.
Migration from existing packages to Gen-Z packages will not apply. That why, existing customer who were born between 1997 and 2012 will be able to enjoy the above mentioned offers but the default package tariff will remain unchanged. Further, the plug and play offer will also not be applicable to said customers.
New customer was born between 1997 and 2012 will get a SIM against a single NID. However, if the customer already has a Teletalk SIM in his/her NID, then the customer can enjoy the promotional offers of the Gen-Z package by dial *111# or clicking on My Teletalk app banner.
Additional duty, VAT and surcharge will be applicable on default tariff but promotional offers such as special data offer, bundle offer, data offer for unlimited period etc are inclusive of Supplementary duty, VAT and surcharge.
For online pre-registration (to purchase "Gen-Z" SIM) please click here:
